nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: Claude Code project-level settings defining allowed permissions for bash, read, and write operations within the NexTElevate workspace.

nodes.name: copilot-instructions.md
nodes.summary: GitHub Copilot coding guidelines enforcing strict TypeScript and ESLint rules including no-any policy and type-safety requirements for AI-assisted development.

nodes.name: pull_request_template.md
nodes.summary: GitHub pull request template with structured sections for summary, changes, type of change, testing notes, and reviewer guidance.

nodes.name: pre-commit
nodes.summary: Husky git pre-commit hook that enforces code quality checks before each commit, ensuring linting and formatting standards are met.

nodes.name: .prettierignore
nodes.summary: Prettier formatter ignore rules excluding generated files and directories like node_modules and .next from code formatting.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Understand-Anything plugin ignore rules listing paths to exclude from codebase analysis, including generated artifacts, test fixtures, and third-party code.

nodes.name: loading.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin-route chat loading skeleton shown by Next.js while the project chat page streams in, rendering a full-screen animated placeholder.

nodes.name: loading.tsx
nodes.summary: Member-route chat loading skeleton shown by Next.js while the project chat page streams in, rendering a full-screen animated placeholder.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Global Tailwind CSS base stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for the design token color system (light and dark themes) consumed across the entire application.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties with Tailwind v4 @theme and @layer base syntax for a dark/light mode token system.

nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Root Next.js App Router layout that sets site-wide metadata (title: NexTElevate) and wraps all pages in the base HTML shell importing global styles.

nodes.name: loading.tsx
nodes.summary: Root-level Next.js loading boundary component rendering a full-screen spinner shown while any top-level page suspense boundary resolves.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Root application page that immediately redirects users to the dashboard, acting as the default entry point after authentication.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config enforcing strict TypeScript rules including no-explicit-any as an error, no-unused-vars, and Next.js best-practice plugin rules across the project.

nodes.name: realm.json
nodes.summary: Keycloak realm bootstrap configuration defining the NexTElevate realm with OIDC client settings, email login, and initial seed users for development.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines the OIDC realm used when AUTH_PROVIDER=oidc; includes a confidential client with the next-auth redirect URI.

nodes.name: run.sh
nodes.summary: Bash script orchestrating k6 load tests with multiple named scenarios (smoke, chat, search, full) each with configurable VU counts, durations, and threshold parameters targeting the NexTElevate app.

nodes.name: seed-users.mjs
nodes.summary: Node.js seed script that inserts 10 test users into the Postgres database and assigns them to a designated project, preparing the environment for load testing.

nodes.name: summit.js
nodes.summary: k6 load test script defining exported chat and search scenario functions, authentication helpers, and custom metrics (latency, error counters) to benchmark the NexTElevate portal under concurrent user load.

nodes.name: next-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated Next.js TypeScript ambient declaration file that includes Next.js type definitions for image, link, and server component types.
nodes.languageNotes: This file is auto-generated by Next.js and should not be manually edited.

nodes.name: next.config.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js production configuration enabling standalone output, 10 MB server action body limit, external packages for @xenova/transformers (local embeddings), and file tracing for ONNX runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: serverExternalPackages prevents Next.js from bundling heavy ONNX/transformer packages, keeping them as Node.js native requires to avoid binary compatibility issues.

nodes.name: postcss.config.mjs
nodes.summary: PostCSS configuration enabling the Tailwind CSS plugin for utility class generation and CSS custom property processing.

nodes.name: add_learning_feedback_features.sql
nodes.summary: Legacy SQL migration adding quiz_coaching_plans and chat_answer_feedback tables plus supporting indexes for learning feedback features.

nodes.name: add_project_announcements.sql
nodes.summary: Legacy SQL migration creating the project_announcements table for admin broadcast messages to project members.

nodes.name: schema.sql
nodes.summary: Complete baseline Postgres schema defining all 30+ tables for the NexTElevate portal including users, projects, documents, RAG chunks, quiz, chat, jobs, and observability tables, with pgvector and pgcrypto dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Requires pgvector extension for embedding storage (vector type) and pgcrypto for UUID generation (gen_random_uuid()).

nodes.name: proxy.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js Edge middleware that performs lightweight session-cookie presence checks to redirect unauthenticated users to /login, avoiding heavy NextAuth imports incompatible with the Edge runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Exported as proxy (not default) with a named config matcher; the Edge runtime constraint prevents importing openid-client, so only cookie presence is checked here.

nodes.name: connector-setup-guide.md
nodes.summary: End-user documentation guide covering setup instructions for all six supported document connectors (Confluence, SharePoint, Jira, Monday.com, OneDrive, GitHub), including credential retrieval steps and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: AdminProjectChatLoading
nodes.summary: Next.js loading UI component for the admin project chat route, rendering an animated skeleton while the page suspense resolves.

nodes.name: MemberProjectChatLoading
nodes.summary: Next.js loading UI component for the member project chat route, rendering an animated skeleton while the page suspense resolves.

nodes.name: authenticate
nodes.summary: Performs CSRF-protected NextAuth credentials login for a virtual user, returning session cookies for subsequent authenticated k6 requests.

nodes.name: chatScenario
nodes.summary: k6 exported scenario that authenticates a virtual user, selects a random project, sends a chat question via the API, and records latency and error metrics.

nodes.name: searchScenario
nodes.summary: k6 exported scenario that authenticates a virtual user and performs a document search query, checking response correctness and recording search error metrics.

nodes.name: proxy
nodes.summary: Edge middleware function that allows public paths and API routes through, and redirects any request without a NextAuth session cookie to the login page.

nodes.name: quiz_coaching_plans
nodes.summary: Legacy migration table storing AI-generated coaching plans linked to quiz attempts with weak section identification and learning recommendations per user.

nodes.name: chat_answer_feedback
nodes.summary: Legacy migration table capturing per-message user feedback (ratings, reason tags, and comments) on AI chat answers.

nodes.name: project_announcements
nodes.summary: Legacy migration table for broadcast announcements sent by admins to project members, storing title, message body, and sender.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Core user identity table storing email, hashed password, global role (admin/member), and account status for all NexTElevate users.

nodes.name: invite_tokens
nodes.summary: Invite token table enabling email-based user registration with optional project-scoped role assignment.

nodes.name: projects
nodes.summary: Core projects table defining knowledge-transfer products with name, pass threshold, quiz close date, and creator reference.

nodes.name: project_members
nodes.summary: Join table assigning users to projects with a project-scoped role (admin or member) and assignment timestamp.

nodes.name: project_announcements
nodes.summary: Project announcements table for admin broadcast messages to project members, canonical version matching the legacy migration.

nodes.name: document_connectors
nodes.summary: Connector configuration table for external document sources (Confluence, SharePoint, Jira, GitHub, OneDrive, Monday) with sync status, auto-sync flag, and encrypted config.

nodes.name: documents
nodes.summary: Document registry table tracking uploaded files per project with metadata for classification, PII scan flags, and optional connector sync provenance.

nodes.name: document_chunks
nodes.summary: RAG chunk storage table holding text content, full-text search vector, pgvector embedding, and embedding model version for cosine similarity retrieval.

nodes.name: document_threads
nodes.summary: Document discussion thread table tracking annotation threads on documents with status lifecycle, resolver tracking, and optional bot or gap-query source.

nodes.name: chat_sessions
nodes.summary: Chat session registry linking users to per-project conversation threads with message count and last-message timestamp for display ordering.

nodes.name: chat_messages
nodes.summary: Individual chat message table storing role (user/assistant), content, and RAG source references per session.

nodes.name: chat_answer_feedback
nodes.summary: Canonical chat answer feedback table recording user ratings and qualitative comments on AI-generated chat responses.

nodes.name: quiz_sets
nodes.summary: Quiz set configuration table grouping questions into named sets per project with active flag and ordering.

nodes.name: quiz_questions
nodes.summary: Quiz question table storing four-option multiple choice questions with correct answer, explanation, and marks value.

nodes.name: quiz_attempts
nodes.summary: Active quiz attempt table recording per-user quiz responses, scores, pass/fail status, and submission timestamps for readiness assessments.

nodes.name: quiz_coaching_plans
nodes.summary: Canonical quiz coaching plans table storing AI-generated recommendations for quiz retakers based on weak section analysis.

nodes.name: processing_jobs
nodes.summary: Postgres-backed job queue table for async background work (document processing, quiz generation, connector sync) with status lifecycle and error tracking.

nodes.name: app_error_events
nodes.summary: Application error event log storing source, category, message, and stack traces for the Admin System Health page.

nodes.name: rag_traces
nodes.summary: Observability table capturing per-request RAG pipeline metrics including retrieval latency, similarity scores, token counts, and hallucination/refusal flags for the admin analytics panel.

nodes.name: user_memories
nodes.summary: Persistent user memory store for the AI chat system, keying personalized context snippets by memory_key with confidence scores and tags per project.

nodes.name: flashcards
nodes.summary: Flashcard table storing AI-generated question/answer pairs sourced from document chunks per project with difficulty rating.

nodes.name: activity_log
nodes.summary: User activity audit log recording action events with metadata for compliance and analytics purposes.
